text.tspan: • Routing policy: how Route 53 answers queries
• TTL (time to live): seconds a resolver may cache it
CNAME → another hostname (never at the zone apex)
NS → name servers of the hosted zone
Also: CAA DS HTTPS MX NAPTR PTR SOA SPF
SRV SSHFP SVCB TLSA TXT (SPF: use TXT now)
Public hosted zone: answers the internet
Route 53 gives 4 name servers; put them at
Private hosted zone: answers only inside VPCs
one or more VPCs; VPC needs enableDnsHostnames
• records may be out of date longer
• records out of date for less time
• lower it before a change, wait
